decision_table.measured: five graphs on the production writer's bytes, twelve transitions each, with the source-qualified identity carried as invisible custom properties
decision_table.not_measured: graphs this slice did not write, binary FBX, and any importer setting other than the hierarchy sort
decision_table.production_cost: a writer change plus a persisted occurrence identity
decision_table.user_workflow: none: the file is imported the way it is imported today

decision_table.measured: what 6000.4.10f1 writes into a model's .fbx.meta, what public API names it, what a direct edit does, and whether it survives a re-export, a real change, deleting the .meta and a sidecar written before the first import
decision_table.not_measured: editor versions other than 6000.4.10f1, and any table Unity writes for asset types this slice does not import
decision_table.user_workflow: the sidecar has to travel with the file and stay in version control

decision_table.measured: SourceAssetIdentifier and AddRemap for Mesh, Material and GameObject separately, with a stored reference across each transition
decision_table.not_measured: types other than those three, and remapping to assets a project already owns rather than to copies made here
decision_table.production_cost: not a writer change at all: a project-side convention plus a tool that maintains the map
decision_table.user_workflow: one external asset per remapped object, kept in the project and re-pointed by hand whenever a designation changes

decision_table.measured: AddObjectToAsset identifiers derived from the full durable identity, for GameObject, Mesh and Material, over the same transitions, plus a deliberate identifier collision and whether a ScriptedImporter can own .fbx
decision_table.not_measured: reading real FBX bytes from a ScriptedImporter, packaging, and anything about how such a package would be distributed or versioned
decision_table.production_cost: a Unity package, its own importer, and its own file format read on the Unity side
decision_table.user_workflow: install a FerriteCAD Unity package, and export the extension it owns rather than .fbx

decision_table.measured: by §22B-1e2a, on the flat graph: references kept except one shared Mesh under an earlier-sibling insert, and every name a person reads becomes a token
decision_table.not_measured: nothing new here; this row exists so the fallback sits in the same table as the mechanisms it competes with
decision_table.production_cost: a writer change plus a persisted occurrence identity
decision_table.user_workflow: the hierarchy, the mesh list and the material list read as tokens

decision_table.measured: the control, here and in §22B-1e1: the references that break are named and counted rather than described as a risk
decision_table.mechanism: 6. human names without a durable-reference guarantee
decision_table.not_measured: nothing new here; it is the product as it ships
